briefs.label: Morning Brief
briefs.title: Tax Fight Turns Political as National Rescheduling & Psychedelics Momentum Builds
briefs.top: Michigan's cannabis industry is finding a political lifeline against the 24% wholesale tax just as JARS and Grön expand their footprints in-state. Nationally, courts, the FDA, and Wall Street are all moving cannabis and psychedelics further into the mainstream this week.

local.text: MiCIA endorses John James over tax repeal pledge
local.detail: The Michigan Cannabis Industry Association threw its weight behind GOP gubernatorial nominee John James, calling him the clear choice for the industry over his 24% wholesale tax repeal promise.
local.text_full: MiCIA endorses John James over tax repeal pledge — The Michigan Cannabis Industry Association threw its weight behind GOP gubernatorial nominee John James over his pledge to repeal the 24% wholesale tax.

local.text: JARS Cannabis buys its way into Arizona's top spot
local.detail: The Michigan-based chain is acquiring Sonoran Roots and its eight Ponderosa dispensaries, a deal that will make JARS the largest dispensary chain in Arizona.
local.text_full: JARS Cannabis buys its way into Arizona's top spot — The Michigan-based chain is acquiring Sonoran Roots and its eight Ponderosa brand dispensaries, set to become the largest chain in Arizona.

local.text: Grön's Pearls gummies hit Michigan shelves
local.detail: Wyld-owned Grön's bestselling Pearls gummies are now confirmed at Pure Options, High Profile and Lume as part of a four-state rollout.
local.text_full: Grön's Pearls gummies hit Michigan shelves — Wyld-owned Grön's bestselling Pearls gummies are now confirmed on shelves at Pure Options, High Profile and Lume as part of a four-state rollout.

local.text: Repeal bill gains traction as tax revenue falls short
local.detail: A Republican lawmaker's HB 6224 to kill the wholesale tax gets fresh ammunition after the levy pulled in just $37 million in Q2 against a $105 million quarterly projection.
local.text_full: Repeal bill gains traction as tax revenue falls short — HB 6224 to repeal the wholesale tax gains ammunition after the levy generated just $37 million in Q2 versus a $105 million quarterly projection.

local.text: Rize keeps growing in the U.P. by splitting the tax hit
local.detail: While Higher Love shuttered five of nine U.P. locations over the tax, Rize sustained growth by negotiating cost-sharing arrangements with suppliers instead of absorbing the hit alone.
local.text_full: Rize keeps growing in the U.P. by splitting the tax hit — While Higher Love shuttered five of nine U.P. locations over the tax, Rize sustained growth by negotiating cost-sharing deals with suppliers.

national.text: DC Circuit upholds medical marijuana's Schedule III move
national.detail: The federal appeals court rejected a challenge to the April rescheduling order, finding opponents had not shown the change was unlawful.
national.text_full: DC Circuit upholds medical marijuana's Schedule III move — The federal appeals court rejected a challenge to the April rescheduling order on Sept. 9, finding opponents hadn't proven the change unlawful.

national.text: FDA convenes landmark hearing on psychedelic therapies
national.detail: The agency held a public hearing Sept. 14 on the potential future therapeutic use of psychedelic drugs, part of a wave of regulatory engagement this year.
national.text_full: FDA convenes landmark hearing on psychedelic therapies — The agency held a Sept. 14 public hearing on the future therapeutic use of psychedelic drugs, part of its accelerated 2026 engagement.

national.text: Compass Pathways closes in on psilocybin approval
national.detail: Analysts anticipate a possible FDA approval by year-end as Compass moves through a rolling NDA submission for its COMP360 depression treatment.
national.text_full: Compass Pathways closes in on psilocybin approval — Analysts anticipate a possible FDA approval by year-end as Compass moves through its rolling NDA submission for COMP360.

national.text: Apollo drops $1.5B on MJBizCon's parent company
national.detail: Apollo Global Management agreed to take Emerald Holding, owner of MJBizCon, private in an all-cash deal signaling consolidation in cannabis B2B events.
national.text_full: Apollo drops $1.5B on MJBizCon's parent company — Apollo Global Management agreed to take Emerald Holding, owner of MJBizCon, private in an all-cash deal.

national.text: Trump delays hemp THC ban, buying operators time
national.detail: The federal ban on hemp-derived THC products was pushed from Nov. 12 to Dec. 11, giving compliant brands another month to adjust before Congress acts.
national.text_full: Trump delays hemp THC ban, buying operators time — The federal ban on hemp-derived THC products was pushed from Nov. 12 to Dec. 11 under a bill Trump signed last week.
